games.name: [Valentines + Skins] Critical Legends
games.desc:
Critical Legends is now officially discontinued. However, the game will not be shutting down.
I've simply reached a point where I want to move on and focus on other projects and interests. Please don't be angry or disappointed. Sometimes the healthiest decision a creator can make is to move forward when a project no longer brings them fulfillment.

I hope you can understand my decision.
To everyone who has played, supported, contributed to, or simply been part of this community:

Thank you.

Thank you for the memories, the support, and for making Critical Legends what it became.


[v4.0.2]
Full log in our server

Enter the captivating realm of Critical Legends, where epic adventures shape timeless legacies. Traverse forbidden terrain, face exotic foes, and emerge as a legend. Trading within this world is an art—use "!trade USERNAME" in Roblox chat, waiting two minutes between trades. All thanks to the visionary Radi Studios, the architects of this wondrous realm!
